items.subject: Grocery matching soundness: 1 condition(s) need action
evidence: 98f7c0 body (08:19:43, emitter grocery/audit-match-soundness.ps1): 'Grocery matching soundness - 1 condition(s). Each is its own triage-queue item with its own type. [CONTESTED CROWN] - NEW-CONTESTED [FORM] (Chilled) Freshness Guaranteed Lemon Pepper Rotisserie Chicken, 36 oz | chain: rotisserie-chicken (each) > lemon-pepper-seasoning (oz) | engine: per-each (weight is one unit) = 3.97/each | holds a CROWN: rotisserie-chicken @ Walmart 3.97/each'

abf660 body (08:19:41, same emitter, same run): the identical NEW-CONTESTED line, same product, same chain, same 3.97/each crown at Walmart. The rollup names exactly one condition and it is abf660's; no other condition is in it.
items.root_cause: audit-match-soundness.ps1 sends a per-condition alert AND a rollup alert for the same run, so every soundness finding is queued twice under two types (the rollup type is marked unregistered: true); the underlying condition is the contested rotisserie-chicken crown the reviewer is diagnosing as 2026-09-30-abf660 in plan-2026-10-01-2.json
items.root_fix_none_because: no code change in this lane: the condition is fixed or decided under the primary 2026-09-30-abf660 (reviewer, plan-2026-10-01-2.json), and its prevention item owns audit-match-soundness.ps1; the rollup-duplicates-the-per-condition-alert shape is recorded in leaves_open for that owner
items.leaves_open: the rollup type 'grocery matching soundness condition s need action' re-queues every per-condition soundness alert (3 occurrences in 30 days: 2026-09-24-3b1e6e, 2026-09-29-af1fdd, 2026-09-30-98f7c0); owned by the primary's plan
items.resolution_note: Superseded by 2026-09-30-abf660: the rollup's one condition is abf660's NEW-CONTESTED rotisserie-chicken crown (Walmart 3.97/each), same emitter, same run two seconds apart. Closes with the primary.
